summary: Short kerb at a busy junction with no-stopping and clearway signs.

drivers.seclusion: Commercial buildings only, no homes near; but fully exposed at the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb narrows into the junction with chevrons and a signal pole; no room to stop.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time, Clearway Mon-Fri 7am-7pm and a 2P parallel sign cover the area.

flags: No Stopping sign contradicts the nearby 2P parking
sun_shade: Open to sun; large buildings to the south-east.
